data.name: Sobre_P1
data.value: HomePlanner was born from a real need: organizing a family's routine — what to cook, what to buy and what everyone needs to do — without jumping between several confusing apps.

data.name: Sobre_P2
data.value: We believe planning the week should be calm and even enjoyable. That's why we built a beautiful, simple, multilingual tool designed for real families.

data.name: Sobre_MissaoTexto
data.value: Give families back time and peace of mind, one menu at a time.

data.name: Sobre_HeroTitulo
data.value: Software built by someone who knows what they're doing

data.name: Sobre_HeroSubtitulo
data.value: SiderisX builds reliable, well-architected software. HomePlanner was created from scratch to organize the routines of real families — with the quality that comes from 25 years of experience.

data.name: Sobre_FounderBio1
data.value: Over 25 years as a developer, with the last 5 working as a software architect. Throughout my career, I have served clients in several countries — including work as a consultant for IBM Canada — on projects of all scales, from startups to enterprise.

data.name: Sobre_FounderBio2
data.value: I have team leadership experience forged in Scrum Master, Tech Lead, and management roles. I adapt well to different environments and continuously strive to grow technically and personally.

data.name: Sobre_FounderBio3
data.value: I was recognized by the Microsoft MTAC (Microsoft Technical Audience Contributor) program, which brings together professionals who present Microsoft technologies at conferences, blog posts, and events. I also worked as a programming instructor, which sharpened my communication with groups and multidisciplinary teams.

data.name: Sobre_FounderBio4
data.value: I speak and write Portuguese and Spanish as a native, and English and French at an advanced level.

data.name: Sobre_DifSubtitulo
data.value: A system built with solid architecture, by someone with decades of real experience.

data.name: Sobre_Dif1Desc
data.value: A scalable, multi-tenant system with well-designed layers, keeping each family's data isolated and secure.

data.name: Sobre_Dif2Desc
data.value: Every feature was designed for the everyday life of a household. No unnecessary complexity, no features that serve no purpose.

data.name: Sobre_Dif3Desc
data.value: Clients in several countries, including consulting work for IBM Canada. Reliability tested on projects of all sizes.

data.name: Sobre_Dif4Desc
data.value: Recognized by the Microsoft MTAC program. Teaching background ensures clear documentation, quality support, and continuous system evolution.

data.name: Sobre_CtaTitulo
data.value: Have questions or want to learn more?

data.name: Sobre_CtaSubtitulo
data.value: Get in touch — we respond within 1 business day.

data.name: Legal_Minuta
data.value: This is a preliminary document, subject to legal review.

data.name: Priv_Corpo
data.value:
HomePlanner (SiderisX) processes your personal data (name, email and usage data) only to operate the family planning service.

We do not sell your data. We share it only with essential providers (Stripe for payments, hosting and email).

You may request access, correction or deletion of your data at any time through our contact channel.

data.name: Termos_Corpo
data.value:
By using HomePlanner you agree to these terms. The service is offered by subscription, with a 30-day free trial.

You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for the use of your account. The data you enter belongs to you.

The service is provided "as is". We may update these terms with 15 days' notice.
